verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical and share the same flaws. The VOLTSTRIDE box, which is the hero product, has shrunk to a tiny chip squeezed into the left gutter, and the 48H badge sits in that same narrow strip. The lime panel is pushed off-centre to the right, the headline runs almost to the panel's right edge, and a large empty gap separates the headline from the body copy and CTA. A is slightly better because its panel sits more evenly on the canvas. B's panel starts lower and ends only about 48px from the bottom edge, which crowds the bottom and leaves too much empty space at the top.
